# How to translate this chunk

This file holds `items`, a list of `{"k", "ctx", "t"}`. `t` is English text
that a reader of an Indian app or website sees. `ctx` is the field it came
from, such as label, hint, button, documents, brief or title. Use it to judge
tone and length: a label stays short, a hint can be a sentence.

Write `{"items": [{"k": ..., "t": ...}, ...]}` to the path in `write_to`.
Keep every `k` unchanged and in the same order. Put the translation in `t`.
Leave out `ctx`. Do not add, merge, split or drop items.

## Keep these exactly as they are

- Placeholders and markup: `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s`, `%d`, `%1$s`, HTML tags, `\n`.
- Website addresses, e-mail addresses and links.
- Every number: phone and toll-free numbers, Aadhaar, account, IFSC, PAN, PIN
  codes, amounts, dates, percentages. Write digits as 0-9, the Western digits,
  in every language, including Urdu. People type these into forms that take
  Western digits.
- Acronyms people know in Latin letters: OTP, PAN, IFSC, UPI, KYC, e-KYC, DBT,
  BPL, APL, NFSA, PM-KISAN, SMS, PDF, ID.

## Names

- Product, app, portal and scheme names: transliterate them into the script so
  they read naturally. Keep any acronym inside them in Latin, so "APPSC
  portal" becomes APPSC followed by the word for portal.
- A button or menu label quoted from a website, such as 'Apply Online' or
  'Register', stays in English inside quotes. The reader has to find that exact
  English word on the screen.
- People and places in examples are transliterated, never replaced with other
  names.
- Government office titles are transliterated so the reader can say them at
  the counter: Tahsildar, Patwari, Talathi, Mamlatdar, BDO, Collector, Gram
  Panchayat. The language notes below give the usual local forms.

## Tone

Write for an ordinary person who may be elderly and may have had little
schooling. Use everyday spoken language, not heavy official vocabulary. Where
people really say the English word, write it in the script: online, form,
portal, login, mobile, bank, certificate, download, upload, app. Keep
instructions short and direct, in the form "do this".

"Gender" means sex (male or female). It is never the word for caste.

## Before you write

Check that you have the same number of items as the input and that every
number and placeholder came through. Write the whole file in ONE Write call,
as valid UTF-8 JSON with no `\u` escapes and nothing else in the file.

Manav Kalyan Yojana (Free Tool Kit by e-Voucher)
Commissioner of Cottage & Rural Industries, Industries & Mines Department, Gujarat

A free tool kit for starting a small trade: beauty parlour, embroidery, plumbing, vehicle servicing and repair, papad making, pickle making, electric appliance repair, milk and curd selling, puncture repair or centring work. Since 2024 the kit comes as an e-voucher (a QR code) that you use at an approved dealer, and you can also choose 5 days of training paid at Rs.500 a day. The old Manav Garima Yojana has been merged into this scheme; tailoring, carpentry, cobbler, barber and some other trades moved to PM Vishwakarma. You apply on the e-Kutir portal when the yearly window opens (the 2026-27 window opened on 17 June 2026), and when there are more applicants than kits a computerised draw decides.

e-Nirman Card - Construction Worker Registration (BOCW)
Gujarat Building & Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board, Labour, Skill Development & Employment Department

The e-Nirman card registers a construction worker with the Gujarat construction workers' welfare board. With it you and your family can eat a full meal for Rs.5 at Shramik Annapurna centres, you are covered under the PMJAY-MA health card, and you can apply on the Sanman portal for the board's schemes - maternity help, children's education, housing help, illness and accident help. PMJAY-MA Yojana - Mukhyamantri Amrutum (MA Card)
Health & Family Welfare Department, Gujarat (State Health Agency, PMJAY-MA)

Gujarat's own health cover, joined with Ayushman Bharat: cashless treatment of up to Rs.10 lakh a year for the whole family at empanelled government and private hospitals. The old MA (Mukhyamantri Amrutum) and MA Vatsalya cards were merged into it in 2021 under the name PMJAY-MA, and in 2023 the cover was doubled from Rs.5 lakh to Rs.10 lakh. Gujarat covers many more families than the central list, including families earning up to Rs.4 lakh a year and senior citizens in families earning up to Rs.6 lakh. The card is the same Ayushman card, and you can make it yourself on the phone or at the kiosk of any government health centre or empanelled hospital.

Mukhyamantri Matrushakti Yojana (Free Monthly Nutrition Kit)
Women & Child Development Department (ICDS), Gujarat

A free nutrition kit every month for a woman in her first pregnancy and until her first child turns two - the first 1000 days. Each month's kit has 2 kg chana, 1 kg tuver dal and 1 litre of groundnut oil, given at the Anganwadi against an OTP on your phone. The health worker first registers the pregnancy in the health department's TeCHO system; you then register yourself on the Matrushakti portal, or the Anganwadi worker does it for you. A ration card is no longer needed - Aadhaar is enough.
